renal.adultMethod: CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine, IDMS-traceable; no race coefficient
renal.exceptionRequirement: Two independent samples at least 90 days apart, stage-4 results in mL/min/{1.73_m2}, explicit iohexol method, both referenced by the Condition evidence. Derived copies do not supply independent confirmation.

hiv.confirmation: Two positive virologic tests on separate samples; source copies and derived results are not independent.

acuteEpisode.appendicitisDisposition: Historical resolved episode, treatment details not captured; unrelated cataract surgery is not treatment evidence. Active persistence needs explicit evidence.
acuteEpisode.futureAbatement: Keep current active state until modeled resolution occurs by the saved timelineAnchor.

anthropometry.referenceDisposition: Omit unvalidated global growth reference ranges and interpretations; these are synthetic generation anchors, not clinical diagnostic ranges.
anthropometry.exceptionRequirement: Final anthropometry assessment with coded supported exception, linked confirmed Condition of the same code, matching subject, timely episode, narrative rationale and a value within the exception model; downstream exact-case review still required.
anthropometry.screenDisposition: Candidate screen relative to age model, not a diagnosis or hard universal clinical threshold.

spirometry.unsupportedDisposition: Cancel test and state not-performed; omit numeric result and exclude from depth/coverage.
